$comment: AUTHORITY for how a Semiont client presents itself to the issuer a knowledge base trusts. The realm registers these clients (the launcher writes the registration), and every SDK and the launcher sign in as them: a client id restated in each language is a sign-in that fails in one of them the day the registration changes. TypeScript: scripts/spec/generate-oauth-clients.mjs writes packages/core/src/generated/oauth-clients.ts. Rust: packages/sdk-rust/build.rs. Go, for the launcher: scripts/spec/generate-oauth-clients-go.mjs writes apps/launcher/internal/launcher/oauth_clients_gen.go.

clients.name: browser
clients.docs: An application a person uses: the authorization-code grant with PKCE (RFC 7636), at a redirect address the registration lists.

clients.name: script
clients.docs: A process with no browser of its own, and the launcher: the device authorization grant (RFC 8628).

scope.docs: What every sign-in asks for. `offline_access` asks for a refresh token that outlives the issuer's own browser session: a session with a knowledge base is renewed for weeks, not minutes.
